definition: The bringing of a memory or feeling into someone's mind.
author: Henry James
quote: But at this evocation she broke down; she dropped, with a sudden sob, upon my sofa and, as I had seen her do before, gave way to all the grief of it.
example_sentence: One whiff of sun cream is an instant evocation of every childhood holiday.
